rationale: The held 12 FR 3909 text confirms EO 9866 (1947-06-14): paragraph 1(a)-(c) sets the Interior succession, paragraph 2 sets the ranking rule and paragraph 3 supersedes EO 9432. The held text of EO 10156 (1950-08-26) restates the succession and in its paragraph 3 expressly supersedes 'Executive Order No. 9866 of June 14, 1947', with no delayed effect or savings clause, so every operative clause was replaced on 1950-08-26. Paragraph 3 of 9866 is a spent supersession. A held-text number search found only the EO 10156 supersession, so no earlier end was found.
